1. The rate quoted should be inclusive of providing manpower, transport charges, GST/ESI/EPF all taxes

2. Applicable other charges, if any should be clearly mentioned. If not mentioned, it will be presumed that
the rate quoted is inclusive of all other charges.
3. The rate has to be quoted in the prescribed tabular column format for all items each for work
measurement. The L1 rate shall be arrived based on the lowest rate quoted.
4. The man power is to be supplied to PPCL site, T.R.Pattinam, Karaikal 609 606.
5. Exact date for commnencement of GBC work will be intimated appropriately and the work has to be

commencement of Works.
8. The number of manpower is estimated quantity. The actual number of manpower may increase or
decrease based on the Plant site conditions during work progress.
